nodes.label: Prefer Wrappers Over Modifying Base Components
nodes.rationale: Wrapping a shadcn base component instead of editing it preserves the upstream API and styling and avoids losing fixes on shadcn updates; editing the base file is only acceptable for bug fixes, upstream sync, or purely structural changes such as adding a data-slot attribute.
nodes.norm_label: prefer wrappers over modifying base components

nodes.label: Default Animation Props Convention
nodes.rationale: Components that accept Framer Motion transition or variants props should ship sensible defaults so the component works out of the box, while still letting consumers override them, so users are never forced to pass animation config.

nodes.label: Concise is Key Principle
nodes.rationale: The context window is shared across conversation history, other skills' metadata, and the current request, so skill content should be pared down to only what the agent doesn't already know; every paragraph must justify its token cost.

nodes.label: Evaluation-Driven Skill Development
nodes.rationale: Build evaluations before writing extensive documentation so a skill solves real, observed gaps rather than imagined problems: run the agent without the skill, identify failures, build three test scenarios, establish a baseline, then write minimal instructions and iterate against the evaluations.

nodes.label: Commit to a Bold Aesthetic Direction
nodes.rationale: Choosing one clear, extreme conceptual direction (brutalist, maximalist, minimal, etc.) and executing it with precision produces distinctive, memorable interfaces; intentionality matters more than intensity, and implementation complexity should scale to match the chosen aesthetic vision.
nodes.norm_label: commit to a bold aesthetic direction

nodes.label: Avoiding Data Waterfalls
nodes.rationale: Sequential awaits inside Server Components create request waterfalls; using Promise.all, Suspense streaming, or a cache()-plus-preload pattern lets independent fetches run concurrently and improves time-to-content.

nodes.label: Do Not Wrap Navigation APIs in Try-Catch
nodes.rationale: redirect(), notFound(), forbidden(), and unauthorized() work by throwing a special Next.js-internal error; wrapping them in try-catch swallows that throw and breaks navigation, so these calls must sit outside try-catch or be re-thrown via unstable_rethrow().
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap navigation apis in try-catch

nodes.label: Import Fonts Once in Root Layout
nodes.rationale: Calling next/font in every component creates a new font instance each time; importing the font once in the root layout and exposing it as a CSS variable avoids duplicate loading and layout shift.
nodes.norm_label: import fonts once in root layout
